accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 5 and Proposition 7
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The boundary-uniform Hessian response and quadratic remainder are unresolved in Open-ended Question 4.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The simultaneous upper band and matching upper separation bound are claimed only conditional on an affirmative resolution of Open-ended Question 4.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 6
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The quadratic-bump lower construction applies only to class-constant tuples with the displayed strict-slack quadratic path.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The minimax lower rate is claimed on that explicitly nondegenerate subclass of nominal class constants, not uniformly over every possible choice of constants.
